messages:
Talia: Last-mile check on the product post 15m please: hero, 3 proof bullets, bench blurb, CTAs, and confirm webinar routing. Need to lock by EOD. :hourglass:
Owen: I'll run hero variants and short social lines. Dropping two options in the doc in 10.
Priya: Taking benchmarks + chart copy. Planning to reference our perf harness v3 and include a one-line test context.
Zoe: I'll wire the HubSpot form + hidden UTMs. Need final utm_campaign and the demo_field name. Suggest utm_campaign=prod_launch_q4 and demo_pref="slot".
Talia: Primary CTA: register for demo. Secondary: request dedicated eval (legal qualifier). Also want a short press blurb for media use.
Owen: Doc link: https://docs.google.com/xxx - chosen hero = variant 1 (short). Social alt: "Predictable LLM latency, out of the box."
Priya: Bench draft: "median latency up to 3.4x faster, p95 up to 1.6x in our internal benchmarks (tests on 1xA100-equivalent; mixed batch, avg seq ~140)." Added a one-line note about the workload and harness.
Sam (Legal): Quick flags: approved use of "up to" and "internal benchmarks". For dedicated eval CTA add "(subject to qualification)". Avoid "guarantee" or "always". I can finalize sign-off at 5pm.
Zoe: HubSpot hidden fields for copy/paste:
```
hidden_fields:
  utm_source: newsletter
  utm_campaign: prod_launch_q4
  demo_slot_field: slot
  lead_route: inbound-beta
```
Zoe: Routing rule: utm_campaign=prod_launch_q4 -> assign queue "launch-inbound"; company_size>300 -> route to Enterprise SDR. Also set sf_tag=launch_interest.
Maya: Webinar ops: I can reserve 13:30 UTC demo pod for launch. Will update Calendly and test the RSVP flow after CTAs are locked.
Talia: Nice. Two small asks: (1) Priya, please add the exact harness repo name for reproducibility. (2) Owen, include a short alt headline for the LinkedIn tile.
Priya: Done - added perf-harness:v3 and the repo link in the doc.
Owen: LinkedIn alt: "Run production LLMs with consistent latency and predictable cost."
Sam (Legal): Signed-off in doc comments with the requested qualifier. Minor edit on bench phrase to add "internal" next to benchmarks inline.
Talia: Locking CTAs and bench language. Proposed publish window = tomorrow 9:30am PT. If no objections by 5pm today I'll schedule publish and queue the social thread for +2 minutes after publish. :rocket:
Owen: Leaving one small A/B hero variant for post-publish test.
Maya: Calendly updated and RSVP test passed. All good from ops.
Talia: Thanks team  closing this thread.
